fertility_source: Births by Parents Characteristics, 2015 edition, Table 6; released 29 November 2016
marriage_source: Marriages in England and Wales: 2019, Figure 2b, 2015 row
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; contains public sector information licensed under OGL v3.0
source_rate_units: per 1000 women in corresponding marital status per year
transformation: Read Table 6 age-specific rate cells and divide by 1000; keep published one-decimal source precision. No age interpolation. Map within marriage/civil partnership to partnered, outside to unpartnered. Total retained only in archival long table and separate overall CSV.
age_endpoint_note: Table 6 uses 15-19 exposure for Under 20 births and 45-49 exposure for 45 and over births. CSV finite endpoint bands reflect exposure ages; endpoint numerators include births outside those bands.
limitations: Marriage and fertility schedules refer to legal status; unmarried includes cohabitation.
Marital fertility includes marriage/civil partnership and small numbers of same-sex-parent births; the marriage series is opposite-sex marriages.
Marriage rates exclude age 15 while fertility starts at 15.
Divorce and non-death dissolution are absent from current simulator.
Long-table total rows cannot be mixed with conditional rows in fertility input.
checks: 357 year/status/age rows, all finite nonnegative rates
Conditional birth counts sum exactly to total counts for each year/age
2015 conditional CSV has 14 rows, overall CSV has 7 rows, marriage CSV has 11 rows
